## About
E Martinez Construction Inc. is a general contractor at 730 Jones Ave in Pinole. Emmanuel and his crew take on bathroom remodels, home additions, kitchen expansions, and backyard work like retaining walls, pavers and patios.
Homeowners who have worked with Emmanuel write about his patience with changes, the care his team puts into the details, and his help getting through permits and inspections. One reviewer called him an "honest contractor" and another "a truly honest and standup guy."
The business holds a 5 star Google rating from 21 reviews.

## Services
- Bathroom remodels: Full bathroom remodels, including one reviewer's master bathroom turned into a spa-like retreat.
- Home additions: Additions to existing homes, including a bathroom and closet space for one family.
- Retaining walls: Replacing old wood retaining walls with concrete blocks.
- Pavers: Taking out old pavers and laying new ones.
- Patio areas: Soil removal and patio areas, including space for a hot tub and stairs.

## FAQ
Q: Will you handle the permits?
A: Homeowners say Emmanuel handled the permit, worked with the engineers and passed the inspections on their addition.

Q: Do you install artificial grass?
A: No. One customer switched their artificial grass plans to pavers because Emmanuel does not do artificial grass.

Q: Have you worked in older neighborhoods?
A: Yes. One reviewer hired Emmanuel for an addition to their home in the historical district of Point Richmond.

## What customers say

Emanuel handled the permit and passed all the inspections including working with the structural engineer and the soil engineer. We just obtained our final inspection sign off on the addition and all the work.

My wife and I are very happy with Emanuel and his team. His patience and flexibility with all my changes and requests and attention to details and he cares about the quality work his team does.
